- Assessment: Exacerbation of eczema (atopic dermatitis) with widespread distribution; very itchy and dry; cracks present on elbows.

- Investigations planned: None.
- Treatment planned:
  - Fexofenadine (antihistamine): dose/route/frequency not documented.
  - Betnovate (betamethasone) topical: apply a very small amount (one fingertip) to affected areas; use twice daily for the next couple of weeks.
  - Emollients: continue Dermal and Diprobase moisturizers.
- Relevant referrals: None.

2) Asthma
- Assessment: History of asthma; currently well controlled between flares.
- Investigations planned: None.
- Treatment planned: Use blue inhaler as needed (PRN); no daily controller therapy discussed.
- Relevant referrals: None.

- Prescription logistics: Prescription sent to Boots pharmacy for collection.
